tasks.title: Joining the Green Neighbours Club
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from the youth leader of the Green Neighbours environmental club, and the notes you have made.

promptBlocks.subject: Welcome to Green Neighbours!
paragraphs: Thanks for your interest in joining Green Neighbours! We're excited to have you.
Our first project is a local park clean-up. We also have a tree-planting day and a recycling workshop. Which project would you like to help with?
Also, are you free on Saturday mornings? That's when we usually meet.
Let me know if you have any questions about the first meeting.

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Say which project you prefer and why.
Tell Maya if Saturday mornings are good for you.
Ask about something you need to bring to the first meeting.
Suggest one idea for a future club project.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Maya using all the notes.

tasks.title: Reducing Household Waste
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: You see this notice on a family website.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: How can families reduce the amount of waste they produce at home?
Tell us about one habit related to food waste and one habit related to packaging that really work.
Also, explain how family members can help each other keep these habits.
Write an article and we will share your ideas with our readers!

tasks.title: The Unusual Discovery
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.

promptBlocks.label: Opening sentence
promptBlocks.text: As I walked along the path through the park, I noticed something strange lying in the grass.
